summary: When someone tags Nora under an Instagram post, she now looks at the post's pictures and videos before she answers, instead of answering from the caption.
details: Up to the first four items are looked at before her turn, the same way instagram_read reads a post's items, and what each shows is in what she reads. More items are counted, not read.
An item that cannot be read in time is shown to her as not read, so she says so rather than guessing; the answer is still given.
Nothing from the post is kept: no media, and no stored reading.
limitations: A video longer than one reading window (90 seconds by default) is not read up front; she can still open it herself.
Reading a reel adds up to about two and a half minutes before she answers, and one video reading's model cost per video.
